Why fictional vessels?

Real vessel tracking requires an AIS subscription and careful handling of position data. This demo uses invented vessels so the interface can be explored without any privacy, licensing or accuracy concerns. See our methodology for how a live version would connect to real data providers.

HORMUZ WATCH

An open shipping-intelligence dashboard for the Strait of Hormuz — vessel activity, energy markets, insurance signals and regional analysis in one place.

Data notice: unless a panel is marked LIVE, all figures are simulated demonstration data. Never use this site for trading, navigation or safety-critical decisions.
